meta.power_rule_note: iteration 3 pre-declared rule: H1 is a confirmatory test only with >= 150 MAIN concepts; hydrated-only count reported separately

rules.MAIN: arm == main AND accepted_primary (p_concept >= t_F1) AND sense_pass (sense_final >= 0.70) AND merged_into is null (canonical at p_merge)
rules.REFERENCE_ACCEPTED: arm == reference AND accepted_primary AND merged_into is null (rho0 benchmark; the full reference arm is a sensitivity set)
rules.SENSITIVITY: the full frame (all 426 concepts), no filters
rules.STRICT: arm == main AND accepted_strict (p_concept >= t_P90) AND sense_pass AND merged_into_strict is null (canonical at p_merge_strict)
rules.frozen_replacement_rule: When a pending concept is hydrated and DS1 assemble.py writes its OpenAlex sense value, that value replaces the proxy (sense_status -> openalex_final) and sense_pass is recomputed with the same 0.70 cut. Nothing else may change: p_concept, thresholds, accept flags, merge clusters and links stay exactly as frozen here.
rules.sense_final: OpenAlex-based DS1 sense check value if present (sense_status openalex_final); else the arXiv year-F title proxy (arxiv_proxy_provisional); else null (missing). null -> sense_pass False for MAIN/STRICT

shift_diagnostic.F4_rule: test F1 < 0.70 or below the C-value baseline -> best CV comparison model's accept flags written as a sensitivity column; MAIN rule unchanged
shift_diagnostic.rule: if termhood-block AUC > 0.90 also compute accepted_primary_notermhood; if Jaccard(primary, notermhood) < 0.80 iteration 3 must run both as a sensitivity pair

link.rule: choose encoder with higher in-KB recall at precision_pi(0.9) >= 0.90 (gated); tie -> MiniLM; SapBERT reported only
